learned_patterns.pattern: The Signal Engine has now missed every fire since 06-30 19:21Z — a multi-day outage, not a one-off. SAFE MODE has held across every session since, freezing the LAB out of new entries. The §2.5 staleness guard is working (no trading on stale signal), but the root cause is the workflow_dispatch/runner never firing. This is the single highest-priority operational fix.

The fractional monitor computes drop vs ENTRY, not vs peak (drop_pct = (current-entry)/entry). INTC round-tripped from +8.8% to -7.4% in two days; a trailing-from-peak stop would likely have fired near ~$122, but the fixed 12.6% stop ($112.06) did not, so the position is held per the documented behavior. Worth revisiting whether fixed-from-entry suits high-ATR names that spike then round-trip — for now, rules honored, no discretionary override.

The whole book fell together on the risk-off reversal (SOXX -7.0%, INTC -6.5%, QQQ -2.3%, NVDA -2.4%, ARKK -1.8%, VOO -0.7%), so tier ratios barely shifted (LAB ~25.6 / CORE ~50.0 / DRIP ~24.0). Diversification doesn't help intraday on a broad down day; the CORE/DRIP no-stop base means we simply hold and buy the dip on the next deposit — the intended §13/§15.4 behavior.

Dividend yields render sanely (JEPQ 9.95%, JEPI 8.10%, SCHD 3.30%) but dividend_growth_streak=0 and payout_ratio=null persist for every DRIP name, so the §15.3 screen (streak>=5, payout<80%) stays unverifiable. Covered-call names (JEPI/JEPQ, payout N/A by rule) can seed on yield alone; dividend-growth names (SCHD/DGRO/VIG/VYM) wait on the streak/payout fix.
